notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.
528 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 5 headings sit at a level the page never opens — "Songs, Word Play, Letters and Numbers" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 5 links on this page open a file — 4 Word, 1 Video — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Give the sub-headings their rule
decisions.why: 4 sub-headings are plain bold text. The design has a treatment for them — a teal rule down the left and a line across — and it had never been used on any page, because it needs a wrapper an author would have to know about.

decisions.label: Draw a closing link as the action it is
decisions.why: 3 passages end with a paragraph holding nothing but a link — the thing the passage was leading up to. Set as running text it looks like any other link in the sentence above it. The site already has one way of drawing an action, so it takes that. The words do not change.

decisions.label: Put the buttons on the house style
decisions.why: 2 buttons use a Bootstrap variant rather than btn-info, so the same kind of action is drawn three different ways across the site. Only the class changes.
